name: Meowstoria
detailed_description:
Meowstoria is an action RPG and adventure game inspired by Diablo and Cat Quest. But here, you can also fish, cook, and enjoy a world full of color and cuteness!

On the continent of Meowstoria, peace is shattered when the Dragon of Calamity unleashes a wave of monsters from the north.

You play as Lionis, a brave (and somewhat clumsy) cat tasked by the High King to defeat the dragon. Luckily, Lionis isn't alone. He's accompanied by Ghost, a powerful wizard ghost whose passion is cooking... monsters!

Discover strange recipes, cook delicious food, eat more, and become stronger!

Explore a world full of wonders, delve into dungeons for epic loot, uncover ancient lost kingdoms, battle curious monsters, and enjoy a hilarious, challenging adventure with a ton of cat humor.

"Slash... cook... eat... become strong"

COMBAT : Hack, Slash, Meowtime

Experience fast-paced combat with a fluid hack-and-slash system that demands precise reflexes and timing.

Master the Perfect Dodge to accurately dodge consecutive attacks to trigger Meowtime, a special ability that slows down time around you.

Use this opportunity to turn the tide and attack your enemies mercilessly!

EPIC BOSS BATTLE

In Meowstoria, each adventure will have you facing giant monsters with unique mechanics.

Boss battles are designed like a souls-like action game: they require timing, reflexes, and courage.

Giant, ferocious monsters that can devour you alive are all waiting to test your skills.

SKILL SYSTEM

Every time you defeat a powerful boss, you'll gain new skills,

which you can combine however you like. Do you want to focus on melee attacks? Or area attacks? Or magic traps? Anything goes!

Experiment with skill combinations to create a unique, dynamic fighting style that suits your style.

COOKING: Cook Monsters, Become Stronger!

In Meowstoria, monsters aren't just for fighting… they're for cooking!

Defeat enemies, collect ingredients, and cook a variety of delicious dishes that grant stat bonuses. Even boss monsters like the ferocious Griffin can be turned into a giant roast turkey.

Eat more, gain special buffs, and become the cat at the top of the food chain!

CRAFTING: Collect, Create and Strengthen Yourself!

Collect materials from monsters, dungeons, and fishing to craft new equipment, upgrade your favorite sword, and continuously strengthen yourself to face tougher challenges.

FISHING: From Ordinary Fish to Legendary Sea Monsters!

Fishing is an essential part of an adventurer's life!

Catch a variety of unique fish and even legendary sea monsters like the Megalodon or the Kraken. Your catch can be cooked or even crafted.

Who knows, perhaps a great secret awaits you beneath the ocean.

DUNGEON: Traps, Monsters, Epic Loot!

Explore mysterious dungeons filled with deadly traps and powerful bosses.

Overcome obstacles, face enemies, and open treasure chests filled with epic loot only true adventurers can find. Perfect for those who love exploration.

PUZZLE

Besides combat, you'll also encounter light and fun puzzles in both dungeons and the open world. Solve these puzzles to unlock new paths, find hidden treasures, or uncover forgotten secrets.

short_description: Adventure in a cat-filled world full of monsters… and the monsters here are edible! Meowstoria is an action RPG with hack-and-slash elements, crafting, fishing, cooking, puzzles, and epic boss battles. Relaxed gameplay, full of cat humor, and monsters aren't just for fighting… they're for cooking!

Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i3 or equivalent
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GTX 750 or equivalent
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10/11
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 or better
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GTX 1050 Ti or better
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
